occupancy of

  • CURIE: gmeow:occupancyOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/occupancyOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The location whose occupancy is measured. Functional: an occupancy measurement concerns exactly one location (constitutive of the measurement's identity).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Occupancy -> gmeow:Location; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:observedFeature

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:occupancyOf from gmeow:Occupancy to gmeow:Location when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:observedFeature, gmeow:Occupancy, gmeow:Location
